text.description:
{Garniture of Interference}

Worn around the neck, this item reduces damage from spells inflicted against the hero's troops by 5%.

{Surcoat of Counterpoise}

Worn about the shoulders, this item reduces damage from spells inflicted against the hero's troops by 10%.

{Boots of Polarity}

Worn on the feet, these boots reduce damage from spells inflicted against the hero's troops by 15%.
